title: question_library_items collection document
description: Membership of one question entity in one question bank. The item references the entity rather than a version, so the bank always resolves to the latest version. Semantic invariants (checked by the service): (library_id, entity_id) is unique, so a bank lists a question at most once; only the bank owner or a user with use permission may add items; note and tags are private annotations of the bank.

entity_id.description: Referenced questions document; the bank always shows its latest version.

note.description: Optional note about why this question is in the bank.

tags.description: Free-form labels; at most 10, each 1..32 characters, no duplicates.
